questions.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 704.1(a), which site condition is required before a building may be constructed?

options.text: It must adjoin or directly access a public space, yard, or street on at least one side.
It must be surrounded by streets on all sides.
It must have no side yard if firewalls are used.
It must use the maximum TGFA before any location check.

rationale.correct: Section 704.1(a) states that the building must adjoin or have direct access to a public space, yard, or street on at least one side.

distractors.B: Section 704.1(a) requires at least one side, not all sides.
distractors.C: Firewall/setback issues are separate controls; they do not replace the Section 704.1(a) location rule.
distractors.D: TGFA comes under Section 705; it does not replace the Section 704.1(a) threshold location rule.

rationale.takeaway: Check Section 704.1(a) location/property access before doing area arithmetic.

questions.text: A question asks for Allowable Maximum Total Gross Floor Area. Which abbreviation should control the computation?

rationale.correct: TGFA means Total Gross Floor Area. Section 705.1-705.2 governs allowable floor areas and TGFA limitation.

distractors.A: AMBF is the Section 704.4 building-footprint control, not total gross floor area.
distractors.C: FSEC is a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance term, not the Rule VII area metric.
distractors.D: NPCP is the plumbing code, not the NBCP floor-area control.

rationale.takeaway: Do not swap Section 705 TGFA and Section 704.4 AMBF; both appear in development-control questions.

questions.text: For eaves over required windows under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 704.1(c), what minimum distance from side and rear property lines is stated?

rationale.correct: Section 704.1(c) states that eaves over required windows shall not be less than 750 mm from the side and rear property lines.

distractors.A: 300 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) value for eaves over required windows.
distractors.B: 500 mm is not the cited value.
distractors.D: 1200 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) eaves-over-required-windows distance.

rationale.takeaway: Attach 750 mm to the exact Section 704.1(c) condition: eaves over required windows, measured from side and rear property lines.
